title: Homebrew Approach to Venture and Community
founder_lessons: Start with one user, one use case, and one solution while learning toward product-market fit.
Articulate both the long-term vision and the path of execution.
Choose hands-on investors only if you want that level of relationship and accountability.
Build trust and transparency around milestones so follow-on decisions are not surprises.
notable_quotes: We're really trying to identify the mission-driven founders, tackling markets, where the pain is large, acute and valuable
we really want founders who are voracious learners.
That seed phase is all about establishing product market fit.
